Legacy snapshots without expectedAppliedValue fall back to the original unconditional restore (unchanged, backward-compatible).

criteria.text: THIRD PASS (this repair): a config-field revert whose value CAS lands in agent_configs but whose live-served opencode profile-file projection is blocked/failed/missing must NOT transition the proposal to 'reverted' — it stays at its current non-terminal status (retryable), and the caller (auto_revert_service.ts) records revert_status='revert_failed' with a safe reason, NEVER 'reverted' (proposal) + 'revert_failed' (event) at the same time. A retry that resumes the SAME transition (field already at its target value) retries projection only — never a second write — and completes once projection settles. The prior separate, AFTER-the-fact 'independent post-write verification' in auto_revert_service.ts (which ran after revertProposal's own terminal transition, leaving a window for exactly this contradiction) is removed — verification now happens INSIDE revertProposal, before its own terminal transition, for both the human #857 path and the unattended auto-revert path.
